newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Firm on cold weather, holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Firm on cold weather, holiday.

text.p: Blustery weather across much of the United States boosted demand for millfeeds on Thursday with limited run times also supportive, cash dealers said.

"It's pretty firm right now because of the cold weather," one North Texas dealer said. "It will be tight next week and the following week because of the holiday but after that I expect (prices) to ease up."
North Texas millfeeds traded at $130 per ton Thursday, unchanged from the previous day but still a high level.
Prices were higher in Chattanooga as mills took down time for the holiday, one broker said.
"Most of the mills are taking down time for the holidays," the broker said. "Bakers are wrapping up for the year. If they haven't done their holiday baking by now it's about too late."
Chattanooga millfeed offers jumped $6 per ton to $118 in thin trading.
